title: Morphology bank
status_note: no manifest exists; the bank must be regenerated (Doc 3 S1). S0.5 pins the schema only.
row_meaning: one row per morphology nid in I_H01

fields.name: arbour_length_um
fields.meaning: total SHAFT cable length after pruning

fields.name: alignment_reference
fields.meaning: identifier of the k-NN reference set

fields.name: lambda_f
fields.meaning: component of Lambda; required by R3

fields.name: nsegs_method
fields.meaning: component of Lambda; required by R3

fields.name: section_vocabulary
fields.meaning: varsigma(nu): the (class, domain) pairs actually present as NEURON sections
fields.note: a property of HOW THE FILE WAS PRODUCED, not of modelling intent, hence per morphology

fields.name: spine_area_density
fields.meaning: spine membrane area per unit shaft length, per branch, arclength-sampled at the pt3dadd vertices of the pruned shaft, stored piecewise-linear in x together with d_0(nu, b) so path distance is recoverable
fields.note: distance dependence is REQUIRED, not optional: spine density is near zero within roughly the proximal 60 um and rises distally, so a distance-resolved phi reproduces that cutoff as an emergent property rather than a hand-set threshold

fields.name: f_implied
fields.note: QC ONLY, NEVER A MULTIPLIER. F(nu, s) is derived per segment at model-build time from phi by equation C8.4 and is never stored (rule R7).

fields.name: exporter_id
fields.meaning: git commit plus function qualname of the exporter
fields.note: the July 2026 bank was produced by the definition at L842 of the chosen exporter while the definition at L1331 shadows it at module scope; this field is what makes that recoverable

derived_never_stored.definition: F(nu, s) = 1 + (integral over [x1(s), x2(s)] of phi(nu, b, d0(nu,b)+x) dx) / A_shaft(nu, s)
derived_never_stored.application_convention_C8_4: F multiplies c_m and multiplies g_pas (equivalently divides R_m), and LEAVES R_a UNCHANGED
derived_never_stored.rationale: storing F per segment would silently expire the moment lambda_f is retuned, and retuning lambda_f is a routine act nobody would treat as invalidating the bank. Storing F per section of the unmerged tree also produced a median of 1.68 with 90th percentile 5.17 and maximum 78.2, a tail arising entirely from very short shaft sections carrying several spines.

derived_quantities.definition: psi = phi / (pi * delta), where delta is the local shaft diameter
derived_quantities.note: the quantity directly comparable to published F-1 values. Only phi is stored; psi is derived.
